title: Replace explicit job reader grants
description: Untrusted browser input for a conditional P1 update. The API derives job, owner, tenant, and current base visibility from server-held state; verifies manage permission, current same-tenant eligibility, allowed actions, and bounded future expiry for each proposed reader; and uses If-Match to prevent lost updates. An empty list revokes all explicit grants. The API rejects duplicate subjects and logs additions, changes, and revocations to append-only audit.

reader_subjects.description: Desired individual grants. Each subject must be unique; the API checks this across objects, enforces a tenant maximum lifetime, and computes server-side grant audit fields.
